question: Should this PR establish claimState, officialState, and restrictionState as the official admin API vocabulary after the derivation bug and runtime proof gap are fixed?
rationale: These names define identity and trust-state semantics that downstream admin clients may treat as authoritative, so maintainer intent is needed before the API contract lands.

options.title: Accept after repair and proof
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the saturated-bucket derivation fix and redacted runtime/API proof, then land the separated state vocabulary as the maintained contract.

options.title: Split spec from API
options.body: Land or rewrite only the internal spec first, and defer the API response field until claim, verification, official, and restriction semantics are settled.

options.title: Defer the vocabulary
options.body: Close or hold the PR until the broader namespace and trust-state RFCs settle the permanent product language.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the saturated-bucket derivation fix and redacted runtime/API proof, then land the separated state vocabulary as the maintained contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current official-publisher admin API/schema paths and CODEOWNERS routing point to Patrick-Erichsen as the best available owner for this contract decision.
